title: A study of $n$-valued non-split maps and applications
summary: For a given $n$-valued map, there exists a suitable minimal covering of the domain such that the composition of this covering with the map yields a split map, composed of $n$ single-valued maps, called the lift factors. Using the group action of the deck-transformation group we construct intermediate covering spaces as well as intermediate configuration spaces, allowing the original map to lift to these spaces, building a tower to illustrate at which level the lift factors split off.
